response.text: Column names are probably uppercase and need quoting.

arguments.sql: select h."JRNL_NO", sum(l."DR_AMT") dr, sum(l."CR_AMT") cr from "GLJRNL" l join "GLJRNH" h on h."JRNL_NO"=l."JRNL_NO" group by h."JRNL_NO" having sum(l."DR_AMT")<>sum(l."CR_AMT")

select l."JRNL_NO", l."LN_SEQ", l."ACCT_CD", l."DR_AMT", l."CR_AMT", c."ACTV_FLG" from "GLJRNL" l left join "GLCOA" c on upper(trim(c."ACCT_CD"))=upper(trim(l."ACCT_CD")) where c."ACCT_CD" is null or c."ACTV_FLG"<>'Y'

select h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", p."STRT_DT", p."END_DT", p."CLOSE_DT", p."STAT_CD", h."SRC_CD", h."SRC_REF" from "GLJRNH" h join "GLPERD" p on p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" where h."POST_DT"<p."STRT_DT" or h."POST_DT">p."END_DT" or (p."STAT_CD"='C' and h."POST_DT">p."CLOSE_DT")

select i."INV_ID", i."INV_NO", i."VEND_CD", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO", i."STAT_CD", (select sum("CR_AMT") from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" and trim(l."ACCT_CD")='2000') cr2000, (select sum("DR_AMT") from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" and trim(l."ACCT_CD")='2000') dr2000 from "APINVH" i where not exists (select 1 from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" and trim(l."ACCT_CD")='2000' and abs(l."CR_AMT"-abs(i."INV_AMT"))<0.005 or l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" and trim(l."ACCT_CD")='2000' and abs(l."DR_AMT"-abs(i."INV_AMT"))<0.005)
